the_fix.HEAD_H: 24 — the header gets a band of its own, derived from the face's metrics rather than chosen: at 16px bone `glyphs.js` puts the cap top 12.38 units above the baseline and the deepest descender 4.55 below it (CAP_EM 0.72, DESCENDER_Y 13.2, BASELINE 10, plus half a 1.5-unit bone stem at u = size*0.072). Baseline 14 (cap top 1.62 inside the band), `boneRule` at 20 (its stroke occupies about [y-3.3, y+2.2], so 22.2, 1.8 clear of the band foot).
the_fix.listTop: = HEAD_H, by construction. It was `Math.max(8, 26 - (fl-1)*20)` — a constant that happened to be big enough until it was not.
the_fix.CROW_H: 32, a NEW container-local row pitch. `ROW_H` stays 34 for the inventory, which is a different screen with 18 rows and its own measured D2. 32 holds the row's 28-unit ICON at ry+3 (bottom 31) and its text ink, which runs ry+9.46 to ry+27.02 at baseline h*0.70. Four rows a side give back 8 of the 16 units HEAD_H costs.
the_fix.BAND_GAP: 10 -> 4. Round 7 measured this gap at 91 ink pixels in 8,640, density 0.0105. Six more units are available because the 'rule' in it does not exist (see `what_i_could_not_do` / A-MIS-USED-HELPER).
the_fix.plate_clamp: `Math.min(150*s, bh - 6*s)` where round 7 had `bh - 20*s`. 150 is the HORIZONTAL cap (the band's text column starts at ix+160); the second term only stops the plate leaving the band, and the plate is drawn at by+6, so bh-6 is the largest square that fits. At r8's bh both forms give 150 — the change is that this one cannot silently starve a 0.4028-density plate the next time the band loses height.

geometry_arithmetic.description_lines: `descLineCap(170, 80, 19)` = 4, the same four round 7 drew. It needs 168.46, so the margin is 1.54 units and the thing that would remove it is any growth of `bandDescTop` or of the header.

the_design.input: `lock_on`. THE ACTION SET IS NOT WIDENED — RI-JRN03 A closes it at sixteen, so what changes is what an existing name MEANS while a screen is open, which is exactly the move `ui/system.js` already makes for `two_hand`. `lock_on` is the closed set's 'fix your attention on this thing'; it is bound on desktop (Tab), on both pad profiles and as a direct touch button; and `grep -rn "pressedName('lock_on')" game/src/` returned NOTHING before this round, so nothing on a paused frame was using it. Gated `!inCombat`, because RI-UIX03 P6 keeps the fight playable with the screen up and in a fight lock-on is lock-on.
the_design.behaviour: Toggles `focus.container.read`. The reading view REPLACES the two lists rather than covering them — an overlay would put its prose across seven rows of names, which is the exact class of defect this round exists to remove and FD4's '0 overlap' has no exception for a panel that meant to. The two side headers stay so the reader still knows which side they are in.
the_design.one_body_two_rects: The resting band and the reading view call ONE function, `drawRecord()`. An expansion drawn by a second copy of the layout is one refactor away from disagreeing with the band about what the record says, and the disagreement would be invisible to `getUIState()` because both would be declaring their own numbers truthfully.
the_design.exits: A second `lock_on` closes it; `back` leaves the reading view BEFORE it leaves the screen, which is `backOrSub()`'s own precedent and stops this being a new instance of GAP-W1-ui-journal-search-view-has-no-exit; and `open('container')` resets it so it cannot survive a close and re-open.
the_design.refusal: `_canExamine()` is false with nothing selected, so the control cannot open an empty reading view. A control that is drawn and does nothing is CRITIC-DOCTRINE 1.2b's hard fail.
